# Managed-project registry parity fixtures

`*.expected.json` files are generated by the vault implementation, not authored
by hand. From the repository root in Git Bash, run:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/c/Users/Keisu/Projects/Notes/obsidian-note/4_Project/Multica-Agent-Strategy/Scripts python plugins/ops/managed-projects-registry/testdata/generate_expected.py
```

The generator calls `managed_projects_registry.load_managed_projects` for every
`*.input.json`; its only temporary registry writes are inside a Python temporary
directory. The fixtures use synthetic Markdown and identifiers only.

Coverage includes all four tables and the table-join override order, missing
required tables, a header mismatch, missing (`n/a`) ID normalization, invalid
booleans, whitespace/backtick cleanup (including a lone backtick), and an
escaped pipe. The Python parser splits table rows on literal `|`, so an escaped
pipe is still rejected as a column-count mismatch; this port intentionally
preserves that behavior.
